judge_known_apelago.scope: A'Pelago-linked companies (accelerator cohorts 2024, 2025, 2026; Pitch Challenge 2025 finalists and 2026 winner) as an answer key for the JunctionX Redstone x A'Pelago demo. Public evidence only.

method.fetch_policy: WebFetch of apelago.fi cohort, programme, news, event and Initiative pages; WebFetch of one descubre.vc article and one Global Fund page; company sites were not fetched in this run.
method.registry_policy: PRH (Finland) queried by name and by business ID with User-Agent junctionx-research-probe/0.1 at about 1 request/second. Brreg (Norway) queried by name. Denmark, Sweden, Spain and Bulgaria are outside the PRH/Brreg scope and were not registry-checked.
method.existing_rows_used: Evidence fields for some companies were taken from the already-collected rows startups_fi.json and startups_nordic.json. Those rows were not re-verified in this run unless stated.
method.personal_data: No user identifiers were sent in any request.

discrepancies: 2026 batch page lists 19 companies; the 2026 cohort page lists 18. WESI Solutions appears only on the batch page.
The 2024 cohort page lists 9 companies, but the programme text says 'cohort of 10 selected ventures'. One venture may be missing from the page.
The 2025 cohort page lists 12 companies, but the 2025 wrap-up news says '14 Startups'. Two may be missing from the page.

Raw row WAIing (WAI Water Intelligence) carries business ID 3380111-1. PRH resolves that ID to Taikoa Oy (registered 2023-08-10), which the raw row describes as the parent. The WAIing entity was not found by name.
Raw row Sub Marine Store: the earlier seed says it designs and builds USVs and ROVs, while the 2026 batch page calls it an online retailer. The build claim is unverified.
Raw row NPHarvest is tagged 'Redstone Blue portfolio'. It also appears as a 2025 A'Pelago Pitch Challenge finalist, so it is included here.
Origin by Ocean appears on the A'Pelago Initiative page only as a previous speaker (CEO), not as a cohort or pitch participant. It is excluded from the alumni list.
Lentola Logistics: the PRH main business line code (30310, civilian air and spacecraft manufacturing) does not obviously match drone logistics. Code kept as found.
Eco Weedkiller (2025 cohort page) and EWK Finland (2025 pitch finalists) are linked by name only. Treated as the same company with low confidence.
Lokala (2025 cohort and finalists) is linked to Oy Lokala Ab (PRH 3434778-2) by name only.
NIDO (2026 batch) and NIDO Contech (2026 pitch winner per one Spanish-language article) are linked by name and product only.

meta.purpose: Answer key for judge-typed famous Nordic ocean and maritime companies (Redstone x A'Pelago, Ocean Opportunity Radar).
meta.method: Registry records from PRH (FI) and Brreg (NO) APIs via a read-only probe with User-Agent junctionx-research-probe/0.1. Company facts from company sites and press pages via WebFetch. WebSearch used 4 of 5 permitted calls. Dealroom, Crunchbase, PitchBook and Tracxn were not used as sources.

evidence_tags.fetched: Read from the company site or a press/primary page in this run
evidence_tags.search_result: Seen only in a WebSearch summary, page not fetched
evidence_tags.not_verified: Not found or not reachable; no claim made

meta.trl_scale: TRL 1-9 (standard NASA-style scale). Bands used here are analyst judgments from the cited evidence, not vendor data.
meta.brl_scale: Analyst bands. 1-3: no named paying customers evidenced. 4-6: named pilots, early or unquantified commercial use. 7-9: multiple named commercial customers or contracts with dated deployments, or disclosed scale.
meta.redstone_window: Pre-seed to Series A, as stated in the brief.
sources_not_reachable: remora-robotics.com and remora.no (reset or DNS failure)

judge_known_redstone.purpose: Answer key for Redstone portfolio companies relevant to the blue economy and the Nordics. Built read-only from redstone.vc, company sites, PRH open data and a capped set of web searches. Bands are inferred from public evidence; 'not stated' means not found in the sources listed.

band_definitions_inferred.TRL: Technology readiness, EC 1-9 scale. Bands: 1-3 concept/lab, 4-5 validation, 6-7 demonstrated in relevant or operational environment, 8-9 qualified/proven in operations.
band_definitions_inferred.BRL: Business readiness, as used in the project's own notes: BRL 6-8 needs paying customers; 1-3 idea/team only; 4-5 pilots or partners without stated revenue; 9 scaled revenue.
band_definitions_inferred.investment_readiness: Qualitative: pre-seed (team, product idea), seed (pilots, early funding), growth (paid customers, institutional rounds), grant-led (public funding is main runway).
